title: WORKSHEET 18
subject: Future in the Past
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 18: Future in the Past

sections.instruction: Join each idea in A with an idea from B. Make sentences using WAS / WERE GOING TO and the verbs in brackets. (Example: I (take) a taxi home last night → I was going to take a taxi home last night, but I didn’t have enough money, so I had to walk.)
sections.contextText:
B:
a) but it rained all afternoon, so we stayed at home.
b) but my boss offered me more money, so I decided to stay.
c) but I didn’t have enough money, so I had to walk.
d) but she had seen it before, so she went to bed early.
e) but her car broke down, so she went by train.
f) but we changed our minds and phoned them instead.

questions.prompt: We (write) to them when we were on holiday,
acceptedAnswers: We were going to write to them when we were on holiday, but we changed our minds and phoned them instead.
questions.explanation: was/were going to: a past plan that didn’t happen (f)

acceptedAnswers: She was going to drive to Scotland last weekend, but her car broke down, so she went by train.
questions.explanation: was/were going to: a past plan that didn’t happen (e)

acceptedAnswers: We were going to play tennis yesterday afternoon, but it rained all afternoon, so we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: was/were going to: a past plan that didn’t happen (a)

questions.prompt: She (watch) the film on TV last night,
acceptedAnswers: She was going to watch the film on TV last night, but she had seen it before, so she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: was/were going to: a past plan that didn’t happen (d)

acceptedAnswers: I was going to change my job last year, but my boss offered me more money, so I decided to stay.
questions.explanation: was/were going to: a past plan that didn’t happen (b)

sections.instruction: Complete the sentences. Use WAS / WERE GOING TO and these verbs: drive / get / go / pick / see

questions.prompt: The train left just as Harold [gap] on it.
acceptedAnswers: was going to get
questions.explanation: was going to: action about to happen in the past

questions.prompt: The shop closed as I [gap] in it.
acceptedAnswers: was going to go
questions.explanation: was going to: action about to happen in the past

questions.prompt: The phone stopped ringing just as I [gap] it up.
acceptedAnswers: was going to pick
questions.explanation: was going to: action about to happen in the past

questions.prompt: We went to the cinema, where we [gap] a film about the Mafia, but it was so popular we couldn’t get in.
acceptedAnswers: were going to see
questions.explanation: were going to: past plan that didn’t happen

questions.prompt: Bob had trouble parking. A car took the last place in the car park just when he [gap] into it.
acceptedAnswers: was going to drive
questions.explanation: was going to: action about to happen in the past

sections.instruction: Use WAS / WERE GOING TO to answer the questions. (Example: Did you travel by train? → No, I was going to travel by train but I changed my mind.)

questions.prompt: Did you buy that jacket you saw in the shop window? → No, I — but I changed my mind.
acceptedAnswers: No, I was going to buy it but I changed my mind.
No, I was going to buy that jacket but I changed my mind.
No, I was going to buy the jacket but I changed my mind.
questions.explanation: was going to + verb: plan that didn’t happen

questions.prompt: Did Sue get married? → No, she — but she —
acceptedAnswers: No, she was going to get married but she changed her mind.
No, she was going to get married but she didn’t.
No, she was going to get married but she decided not to.
questions.explanation: was going to + verb: plan that didn’t happen
